method: Deep-research replay built from the already-frozen 2025Q3 event set. Company evidence and deterministic pre-cutoff price-regime snapshots are bounded by each memo cutoff; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before memo lock.
Pre-cutoff price-regime snapshots use only bars dated on or before their frozen cutoff.
Use as holdout process evidence, not clean forward alpha.
